Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface ArtMeshMorphKeyform

@CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") public interface ArtMeshMorphKeyform
A generation-bound, existing non-basic morph key on a root ArtMesh in a reviewed Editor. Stored positions are absolute values U, not a difference from the ordinary base B. The implicit zero key is the exact ordinary default cell and is read-only here. This initial surface requires normalized, non-repeating 0..1 morph parameters, an unambiguous ordinary grid, and no source-level extended interpolation or constraints.

Membership changes invalidate previously acquired references. Undo, Redo and failure compensation of a morph edit can replace every target record in the source, including unrelated parameters' records: reacquire references after those operations. Detached snapshots remain readable. Stale references throw IllegalStateException.

Loss of the supported authoring domain (for example locking the source or enabling extended interpolation) throws UnsupportedOperationException; malformed stored geometry is rejected by the snapshot contract with IllegalArgumentException.

    • setPositions

      void setPositions(List<Point2> positions)
      Writes only this target's absolute positions, without changing source geometry or sliders. Uses the authoring transaction coordinator; equal positions create no Undo or dirty change.
      Parameters:
      positions - one finite point per existing vertex, in native stored-form coordinates
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the vertex count differs
      NullPointerException - when the list or any point is null
      IllegalStateException - when this reference or its layout is stale
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the exact-version write protocol is unavailable

    • setDrawOrder

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default void setDrawOrder(int drawOrder)
      Writes only this target's absolute stored draw order, not an offset from the ordinary base and never a slider-derived value. Equal orders create no Undo or dirty change.
      Parameters:
      drawOrder - absolute stored order in 0..1000 inclusive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the order is outside 0..1000; it is never clamped
      IllegalStateException - when this reference or its layout is stale
      UnsupportedOperationException - when the exact-version write protocol is unavailable
